title: Internship: Content and Engagement (Bachelor, non-thesis)
description: Job Title Internship: Content and Engagement (Bachelor, non-thesis) Job Description Start Date: as soon as possible Duration: 5-6 months Type: Internship (non-thesis) Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h) Location: Best 588629 Internship: Content and Engagement (Bachelor, non-thesis) In IGT Systems, we have a strong marketing department, with a dedicated Content and Engagement (C&E) team, geared towards creating all customers facing, promotional and campaign material linked to our products and services. You will play a key role in supporting our global Content & Engagement team by helping to organize and optimize our marketing content ecosystem, conducting market and competitive research, and exploring the use of AI tools and agents to improve marketing effectiveness and campaign creation. Your role: In this role, you will support the Content & Engagement team and MarCom Managers specifically by maintaining and optimizing our global asset library, ensuring marketing materials are accurately categorized, easy to find, up to date, and aligned with internal governance standards. You will help improve content discoverability and support the adoption of approved marketing assets across regions. You will conduct desk research and market intelligence activities, gathering insights on customers, competitors, industry trends, congresses, and emerging technologies. Your findings will help inform campaign planning, content development, and strategic marketing initiatives. You will help drive innovation by exploring and developing AI-enabled marketing solutions, including creating and testing prompts, AI agents, and workflow automations that support content creation, campaign development, content localization, and marketing operations. You will collaborate with MarCom Managers and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance productivity and customer engagement. You will support day-to-day marketing activities, including content reviews, campaign execution tasks, reporting, asset coordination, and operational projects that contribute to the successful delivery of global marketing programs. You will work within the Content & Engagement team, reporting to the Content & Engagement Leader in the IGT-S Product Management & Marketing organization and collaborating closely with MarCom Managers, Downstream Marketing Managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders. You’re the right fit if: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Design, Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business. You are proficient in the English language – a must. You have a strong interest in marketing communications, digital content management, and AI-enabled marketing . You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large volumes of digital content and data. You are proficient with Microsoft 365 tools and have experience with, or a strong curiosity about, AI-assisted tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar technologies. You possess strong analytical and communication skills and are comfortable working in an international, collaborative environment. title: Factory Project Manager (all genders)
description: Job Title Factory Project Manager (all genders) Job Description As Project Manager BBN Factory , you will join the production and operations network of Philips' HPM manufacturing site in Böblingen and work closely with PIE, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facility Management and the shop floor. In this high-impact role, you will translate strategic industrialization objectives into operational execution, ensuring the successful and timely introduction of new products in an international environment. As a central coordinator between local and global stakeholders, you will directly contribute to the sustainable development and future readiness of the Böblingen site. You will take end-to-end ownership of complex, production-related projects within the BBN Factory environment, ensuring on-time industrialization and new-product introduction. Acting as the key interface between Product Industrialization Engineering (PIE), Production Process Engineering, the shop floor and other Operations functions, you will coordinate production-line setups, machinery and system implementations, and cross-site initiatives—playing a decisive role in achieving critical NPI milestones. This is an opportunity to shape how innovative patient-monitoring solutions move from industrialization into reliable production, influence a broad international stakeholder network and leave a visible, lasting impact on Philips' global manufacturing organization. Your Role: Job title: End-to-End Project Management: Plan, manage and execute multiple parallel production and industrialization projects in a manufacturing environment, including schedule, resource, cost and risk management. Interface & Stakeholder Management: Closely coordinate between PIE, Production Process Engineering, the shop floor, Facility Management, material supply, logistics, Production Management and operator resource management. QMS & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and Quality Management System processes, particularly in the medical-technology environment, and create, maintain and secure approval of relevant production-side project and process documentation. Supplier & Partner Management: Manage relevant internal and external project partners and work closely with Calibration, Maintenance and Technical Support teams. International Project Coordination: Lead and coordinate international projects across multiple HPM locations, particularly programs involving several sites within a global matrix organization. You're the right fit if: You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, industrial management, or a related field. You have at least 5 years of experience leading manufacturing or industrialization projects across multiple workstreams. You have experience with quality systems and compliance in a regulated sector. You have practical knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured project management. You have experience coordinating global, cross-functional teams. You understand production processes, equipment, robotics, and NPI. You are able to influence without authority and drive actions. You have business-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written. You are able to deliver NPI, quality, and production-readiness milestones. You collaborate effectively across factory and operational functions. Benefits include: Annual leave: 30 days Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…) Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc. Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. description: Job Title Werkzeugmacher / Maschinenbautechniker (All genders) Job Description Werkzeugbautechniker / Maschinenbautechniker (All genders) In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für die eigenständige Steuerung der Fertigungsprozesse in der Als Werkzeugbautechniker bist Du für die Herstellung, Wartung und Instandsetzung von unseren Stanzwerkzeugen zuständig. Deine Aufgaben reichen von den Werkzeugwartungen, Werkzeugreparaturen, Unterstützung unserer Stanzteile Produktion, deren Instandhaltungsteams sowie über die kontinuierliche Verbesserung (KVP) unserer Stanzprozesse. Du schulst Produktionsmitarbeitende und trägst aktiv zur hohen Qualität unserer Produkte bei. Du dokumentierst die Arbeitsergebnisse und stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Zeit und Kosten im Einklang stehen. Dein Job: Herstellung von Spezialwerkzeugen: Du fertigst Stanz- und Biegewerkzeuge sowie Spritzgussformen Maschinelle Bearbeitung: Nutzung von CNC-gesteuerten oder konventionellen Maschinen zum Fräsen, Drehen, Schleifen, um Bauteile mit einer Präzision im Tausendstel-Millimeter-Bereich herzustellen. Montage & Anpassung: Einzelteile werden zu komplexen Baugruppen zusammengefügt, feinstabgestimmt und funktionsfähig gemacht. Instandhaltung: Werkzeuge werden regelmäßig gewartet, auf Verschleiß geprüft und bei Bedarf repariert oder optimiert. Qualitätssicherung: Vermessen der fertigen Teile mit Präzisionsinstrumenten wie Mikrometern, um strikte Qualitätsvorgaben einzuhalten. Ersatzteileverwaltung: definieren, teilweise herstellen und verwalten unserer Ersatzteile mittels unseres SAP Lagersystems. Folgendes solltest Du mitbringen: Werkstoffkunde: Tiefes Wissen über Metalle und Kunststoffe sowie deren Bearbeitungseigenschaften. Maschinenbedienung: Sicherer Umgang mit konventionellen und CNC-gesteuerten Maschinen (Fräsen, Drehen, Schleifen). Verständnis über technische Dokumentationen: Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen sowie die Interpretation um das Werkstück präzise zu fertigen. Technisches Verständnis um (technische) Dokumentationen entsprechend zu verstehen und in die Praxis um zu setzen. Präzisionstechnik: Beherrschen von Messverfahren im Mikrometerbereich. Handwerkliches Geschick: Hohe Fingerfertigkeit für die Montage kleinster Bauteile. Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen: Notwendig für das Umsetzen komplexer 3D-Konstruktionspläne. Sorgfalt & Geduld: Da kleinste Abweichungen Werkzeuge unbrauchbar machen können, ist extrem genaues Arbeiten essenziell. Analytisches Denken: Wichtig für die Fehlersuche und Optimierung von Werkzeugfunktionen. title: MR Systems Architect
description: Job Title MR Systems Architect Job Description Job Description As a MR Systems Architect, you will play a key role in driving system definition, design integration, risk management, and technical problem solving for Philips MR products. You will work across global and local R&D teams to translate system-level requirements into subsystem and component requirements, ensuring product quality, reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful product delivery. You will serve as a critical technical interface between Global System Engineering, System Architects, and component development teams, contributing to the development of next-generation MR systems. Key Responsibilities System Engineering & Architecture Analyze, define, and manage system and subsystem requirements. Drive requirement decomposition from system level to subsystem and component level. Support system architecture design and overall system integration activities. Ensure component designs comply with system requirements and product objectives. Evaluate system performance and reliability through data analysis and engineering methodologies. Technical Leadership Lead technical reviews, design reviews, and feasibility studies. Provide technical guidance throughout the product development lifecycle. Make design recommendations that improve product reliability, performance, and user experience. Support concept exploration, system definition, design verification, issue investigation, and continuous improvement activities. Risk & Quality Management Lead FMEA and risk management activities. Drive defect management and root cause analysis. Investigate technical issues and coordinate corrective and preventive actions. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with Global System Engineering teams, System Architects, PMO, subsystem teams, and component development teams. Influence stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple functions and locations. Facilitate effective communication and decision making throughout development programs. Qualifications Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Electrical Engineering Electronic Engineering Mechanical Engineering Computer Science Biomedical Engineering Or related engineering disciplines. Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in MR Systems Engineering or related medical imaging product development. Solid experience in system design, system integration, and product development. Hands-on experience in risk management, technical problem solving, and reliability engineering. Experience working in a global matrix organization is highly desirable. Required Skills Systems Engineering Methodology System Design & Integration Requirements Engineering FMEA & Risk Management Root Cause Analysis Technical Leadership Stakeholder Management Cross-functional Collaboration Strong Analytical & Problem-solving Skills Ability to Influence and Drive Decisions Across Teams Preferred Qualifications Strong understanding of MR product architecture and technologies. Experience conducting feasibility studies and system-level trade-off analysis. DFSS (Design for Six Sigma) certification. INCOSE CSEP certification or equivalent Systems Engineering qualification. Knowledge of medical device regulations and quality processes. Success Profile The ideal candidate demonstrates: Deep understanding of MR systems and system design methodology. Strong capability in driving technical issues to resolution. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Ability to balance technical depth with system-level thinking. Passion for product quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. About Philips Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? title: Senior System Designer – Sensing Lab
description: Job Title Senior System Designer – Sensing Lab Job Description Job Title System Designer – Sensing Lab Job Description In this role, you will have the opportunity to join the leading innovator in image-guided therapy solutions as System Engineer for Azurion Eye – Sensing Lab proposition . You will be responsible for defining and owning the system design for an integrated sensing, AI, and data analytics environment. You will translate clinical and business requirements into a coherent, scalable, and standards-compliant system design, spanning hardware interfaces, software subsystems, cloud connectivity, and data pipelines. You will act as system ‑ level technical authority, responsible for defining, owning, and evolving the end ‑ to ‑ end system architecture, behavior, and design across software, AI, data, and platform components that enable real ‑ time clinical workflow automation in a regulated medical environment. You will be part of the Image Guided Therapy Systems (IGTS) business unit with development sites in the Netherlands, China and India. You will join the global R&D department working closely with cross-functional product development team s . Key Areas of Responsibility Define and own the system-level architecture & design including hardware interfaces, AI subsystems, data pipelines, and cloud integration. Decompose top-level system requirements into subsystem and component-level specifications; maintain traceability from requirements to design and verification. Collaborate with AI Analytics, Data Analytics, and Infrastructure teams to ensure all subsystems integrate into a coherent and scalable platform. Lead architecture review boards; evaluate design alternatives and document trade-off analyses. Define and manage system interfaces between sensing hardware, embedded software, cloud services, and clinical dashboards. Identify and address non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, safety, cybersecurity, interoperability (DICOM, HL7), and regulatory compliance. Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure the system design adheres to IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and applicable medical device standards. Support verification and validation planning; define system-level test strategies and acceptance criteria. Engage clinical stakeholders to validate system design against real-world lab workflows and usability needs. Mentor engineers across teams on systems thinking, requirements engineering, and architecture best practices. To Succeed in This Role, You Should Have the Following Skills and Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree (or PhD) in Systems Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. 10–15 years of experience in systems engineering for complex hardware/software products; experience in medical devices or health-tech strongly preferred. Proven expertise in system architecture definition, requirements engineering (e.g., SysML , UML), and interface management. Experience with medical device standards and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820). Familiarity with sensing technologies, camera/imaging systems, or clinical lab environments is a strong advantage. Knowledge of cloud architectures (AWS/Azure), microservices, and data pipeline design. Experience with DICOM, HL7, or other healthcare interoperability standards is advantageous . Strong systems thinking: ability to reason across hardware, software, data, and clinical workflow layers simultaneously. Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools (e.g., Cameo, Rhapsody) is an advantage. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate design, documentation, and analysis. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. description: Job Title Senior Reliability Design Engineer Job Description Senior Reliability Design Engineer (Hardware) An experienced Senior Reliability Design Engineer (Hardware) with a strong Electrical/Electronic background to lead reliability engineering activities for complex hardware systems. The role is responsible for driving Design for Reliability (DfR), driving life-cycle performance improvement through reliability prediction, robust design, verification testing, and failure investigation. 高级可靠性设计工程师（硬件） 我们正在寻找一位经验丰富的 高级可靠性设计工程师（硬件） ，具备扎实的电气/电子工程背景，负责复杂硬件系统的可靠性工程工作。该岗位将主导产品可靠性设计（DfR），通过可靠性预测、稳健设计、验证测试及失效分析等手段，持续提升产品全生命周期的可靠性表现。 Your role: Define and deploy Design for Reliability (DfR) methodology throughout product development, with emphasis on electrical/electronic architecture, component selection, derating, and design margins. Establish reliability requirements, reliability budget allocation, prediction models, and reliability growth plans for electro-mechanical and electronic systems. Lead reliability reviews from concept through commercialization. Drive reliability risk identification and mitigation activities for electrical, thermal, mechanical, environmental, and operational stress conditions. Apply robust design methodologies to reduce sensitivity to manufacturing variation, environmental stress, and component tolerances. Develop design margins, derating strategies, and robustness criteria for key electrical/electronic components, assemblies, power/control circuits, sensors, interconnects, and motion-related hardware. Ensure adequate robustness against thermal, mechanical, electrical, vibration, and operational stresses through analysis, design review, and verification planning. Promote first-time-right design philosophy by embedding reliability thinking early. Define reliability verification strategy, reliability testing plan, establish reliability demonstration tests. Drive root cause investigations for failures identified during testing by leveraging relevant tools, i.e., failure tree analysis, DOE, Monte Carlo simulation, etc. 您的职责（Your Role） 在整个产品开发过程中定义并推动可靠性设计（Design for Reliability, DfR）方法论的实施，重点关注电气/电子架构、元器件选型、降额设计（Derating）及设计裕量管理。 建立机电系统和电子系统的可靠性需求、可靠性预算分配、可靠性预测模型以及可靠性增长计划。 从概念设计阶段到产品商业化阶段，主导各阶段的可靠性评审工作。 推动可靠性风险识别与缓解活动，包括电气、热管理、机械、环境及运行工况等方面的风险。 应用稳健设计（Robust Design）方法，降低产品对制造波动、环境应力及元器件公差变化的敏感度。 为关键电气/电子元器件、组件、电源及控制电路、传感器、互连结构以及运动相关硬件制定设计裕量、降额策略和稳健性标准。 通过分析、设计评审和验证规划，确保产品具备充分抵御热应力、机械应力、电气应力、振动及运行工况应力的能力。 倡导“ 一次设计正确（First-Time-Right） ”理念，在产品开发早期植入可靠性思维。 制定可靠性验证策略和测试计划，并建立可靠性验证测试（Reliability Demonstration Test）。 利用失效树分析（FTA）、实验设计（DOE）、蒙特卡洛仿真（Monte Carlo Simulation）等工具，主导测试过程中发现问题的根因分析和失效调查。 You're the right fit if: Master’s or bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronic, reliability, or mechatronics engineering, or a related discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience for complex hardware products, preferably involving electrical/electronic subsystems, power/control electronics, sensors, motion systems, rotating or linear-motion products. 3+ years leading reliability engineering activities for complex hardware products (CT, MR, X-ray, Radiotherapy or other regulated high-reliability systems is highly valued). Demonstrated success applying Robust Design, DFMEA, problem solving, physics-of-failure thinking, and data-driven reliability improvement in new product development. Ability to influence design decisions and drive reliability improvements across global cross-functional teams. Working knowledge of ISO13485, EU MDR, FDA 21 CFR, ISO14971. Strong and practical knowledge of DFMEA, problem solving, Design for Six Sigma (GB/BB) certified candidates are preferred. Good English communication skills (both verbal and written) required. 我们希望您具备（You're the Right Fit If） 电气工程、电子工程、可靠性工程、机电一体化工程或相关专业本科及以上学历； 10年以上复杂硬件产品开发经验 ，优先考虑具备电气/电子子系统、电源与控制电子、传感器、运动控制系统、旋转或直线运动产品开发经验者； 3年以上复杂硬件产品可靠性工程领导经验 ；如具备CT、MR（磁共振）、X-ray（X射线）、放疗设备或其他受监管的高可靠性系统经验将被优先考虑； 在新产品开发过程中，具有成功应用 稳健设计（Robust Design） 、DFMEA、问题解决方法、失效物理（Physics of Failure）及数据驱动可靠性改进的实践经验； 能够影响设计决策，并推动全球跨职能团队开展可靠性改进工作； 熟悉 ISO13485、欧盟MDR、FDA 21 CFR、ISO14971 等医疗器械法规和标准； 具备扎实且实践导向的 DFMEA、问题分析与解决（Problem Solving） 能力；拥有 Design for Six Sigma（DFSS）绿带（GB）或黑带（BB）认证 者优先； 良好的英语听说读写能力，能够进行国际化沟通与协作。 How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. This role requires excellent communication skills, a deep understanding of e-commerce, commercial strategy and the power of social media on the consumer decision journey You are the right fit if: Bring a minimum of 5 years work experience in National Account Management with a strong background in e-commerce. Have worked within a global organization – ideally one that is brand-led and consumer focused. Are comfortable communication in Italian. Possess hands-on experience managing P&L responsibilities. Are skilled in creating impactful presentations and confident using PowerPoint. Have a solid track record of optimizing the customer decision journey and enhancing user experience. Demonstrate strong stakeholder management capabilities, able to align and influence across diverse teams. You are passionate about new technologies and eager to grow and develop your skills. You want to work together and act as a real team player, a great communicator and are comfortable working with different stakeholders. Work closely with the Marketing Manager to deliver content engagement metrics. Responsible for all lower funnel activations on the platform, with a particular focus on Tiktok Shop Lives. Manage portfolio and pricing strategy for the platform, in line with WE guard-rails. Co-create with Marketing Manager a FY activation plan which aligns with the WE Incubator team objectives. Work closely with the Philips Tiktok Shop Agency Partner (TSP) to deliver the activation calendar and ensure all content deliverables are aligned with Philips brand guidelines. Manage A&P and promo spending for the channel- key user for SAP. Track performance across GMV, content engagement and outputs and optimise where needed. Develop strong relationship with the Tiktok Account Management Team to secure brand and commercial unlocks for Philips. Support the Marketing manager with the planning and delivery of handle content, affiliate outreach and ads. Stay up to date with the latest trends on TikTok, and weave best practise into Philips content plan. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Field Service Engineer - Boston, MA
description: Job Title Field Service Engineer - Boston, MA Job Description Field Service Engineer - Boston, MA Allow your passion for improving lives to shine in this role where you’ll be responsible for customer relationship management through the effective use of technical knowledge to install, troubleshoot, service, and maintain equipment at customer sites. Your role: Provide exceptional customer service by adhering to customer entitlements, setting clear expectations, and meeting commitments and arrival times to address and resolve customer needs. Understand the customer's business and competitive environment; generate service revenue. Actively participate as a member of the regional work team; work to improve team processes and identify training gaps. Seek out opportunities to increase capability and capacity (i.e. may be required to become qualified in multiple modalities, learns new tools). Perform all administrative duties within established Philips, State, and Federal regulatory requirements and timeframes including timesheets, service work orders, expense reports, Field Change Orders (FCO), preventative maintenance (PM), installation documents, site and service documentation, and other related paperwork. Adhere to established training, quality, and safety requirements. Utilize tools, support, resources, and escalation processes within required time frames to resolve customer and system problems timely and effectively. Complete PMs, FCOs, installation and all related tasks (diagnose and resolve electronic, network, and mechanical problems). Travel across the specified geography is required. The average driving time is 1-4 hours daily and may exceed 70% at times. Occasional overnight stays and travel by air and/or train may be required. You're the right fit if: You’ve acquired 4+ years of experience in a diagnostic imaging (field or hospital-based) service environment. Your skills include the ability to understand and apply electronic, mechanical, and networking theory to install, diagnose, and repair equipment, including knowledge and use of all necessary tools and test equipment. You have an Associate Degree in electronics or equivalent combination of education and experience; BSEE/BSEET/BSME/BSMET preferred. You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this Field Service position. You must be able to: Work in an office/home office and/or remote setting, as well as in a hospital/healthcare environment; adhere to requirements. Work flexible hours (based on business needs to include overtime, weekends, and on-call rotations). Safely work with radiation sources and/or radioactive materials; wear all required personal protective equipment. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations. This is a field role. We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others. Learn more about our business . Discover our rich and exciting history. Learn more about our purpose. Learn more about our culture. This role also includes field service and lead generation incentive bonus plans, on-call pay, company fleet/car, training, and advancement opportunities. The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive plan, field service incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. title: Account Manager Hospital Patient Monitoring – North East England
description: Job Title Account Manager Hospital Patient Monitoring – North East England Job Description Be part of the change to increase connectivity with patient monitoring and use analytics to pre-empt the care patients need. Your role: Lead the commercial execution of the Hospital Patient Monitoring portfolio across Northeast England , driving growth and ensuring strong alignment with District Leadership and Sales Management. Deliver annual Order Intake and Revenue targets across the NHS Trusts, ICBs, and private hospital customers. Be accountable for sales performance of the Patient Monitoring portfolio, working closely with regional teams to achieve annual Order Intake and Revenue targets across hospital-based customer accounts. Collaborate with Modality Sales Specialists (MSS) and cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, customer-focused solutions. Develop and execute strategic and tactical account plans, informed by win/loss analysis and market intelligence. This role offers flexibility to work from home, with an expectation of up to 60% travel across UK hospital sites to engage with customers, support clinical demonstrations, and drive account growth.
